101 · Foundations · 4 modules · about 7 hours

Digital Marketing 101

Complete beginners: students, career starters, and anyone who needs the map and the vocabulary of digital marketing before any tactics.

Modules

  • Foundations of Digital Marketing and E-Commerce — 6 lessons
  • The Customer Journey and the Marketing Funnel — 9 lessons
  • Strategy and Channels — 11 lessons
  • Measuring Performance — 7 lessons

You will be able to

  • Define marketing, digital marketing, and e-commerce, and explain how digital marketing differs from traditional marketing
  • Describe the customer journey and the marketing funnel, and name the four stages: awareness, consideration, conversion, loyalty
  • Distinguish owned, earned, and paid media, and name the main digital channel families
Open the course
201 · Applied · 5 modules · about 5 hours

Digital Marketing 201

Graduates of Digital Marketing 101 — and practitioners with equivalent foundations — who are ready to apply the concepts: business owners, freelancers, and marketers with a real business to work on, or who want to work the provided practice business end to end.

Modules

  • Positioning and the Offer — 5 lessons
  • Your Numbers: Unit Economics — 5 lessons
  • Content and Social as a System — 5 lessons
  • Email and Owned Audiences — 4 lessons
  • Paid Media and Partnerships — 4 lessons

You will be able to

  • Position a real offer: a precise customer, a stated problem, a specific promise, and named proof for every claim
  • Compute a business's unit economics — lifetime value, allowable acquisition cost, break-even cost per purchase — from stated figures and assumptions
  • Run content and social as a system: pillars, a capacity-honest calendar, and a repurposing chain
Open the course
301 · Advanced · 5 modules · about 5 hours

Digital Marketing 301

Graduates of Digital Marketing 201 — and operators with equivalent experience — who are past first launch and responsible for growth: founders scaling a working business, marketing leads, and freelancers running growth for clients.

Modules

  • Growth Models and Experimentation — 5 lessons
  • Advanced Paid Media and Media Planning — 4 lessons
  • SEO and Content at Scale — 5 lessons
  • Lifecycle and Retention Marketing — 5 lessons
  • Analytics, Dashboards, and the Planning Cycle — 4 lessons

You will be able to

  • Map a business's growth as loops and stages, not just a funnel, and choose where to intervene
  • Design experiments honestly: meaningful hypotheses, realistic effect sizes, and verdicts you can defend
  • Build a full-funnel media plan with budget allocation derived from unit economics, and handle attribution without self-deception
